outcome: complications (ureterovaginal fistula, bladder injury, port-site hernia)
cohort: The study included 210 women who underwent laparoscopic total hysterectomy for benign uterine conditions, primarily uterine fibroids and abnormal uterine bleeding, at a single tertiary care center.
finding: The study found a 2.9% complication rate for laparoscopic total hysterectomy for benign uterine conditions, with specific complications including ureterovaginal fistula, bladder injury, and port-site hernia, noting increased technical challenges in cases with prior cesarean sections or larger uteri.
mod_finding: A history of two prior cesarean sections was present in 31.4% of patients and was noted in one case of bladder injury during the hysterectomy.
